hypothesis: Four causally scored, non-overlapping post-open through afternoon sleeves can diversify intraday timing while sector-flow and leadership factors keep each sleeve in cash unless its own expected return is strong, raising IR structurally rather than by filtering one daily route.
versions: 10 frozen multi-factor families x 5 train-only score quantiles x 2 ridge penalties
causality: Every sleeve's factors end before its next-bar entry. Ridge coefficients and score thresholds use only 2022-2023. Holding intervals do not overlap, so maximum instantaneous gross remains one.
data_contract: Uses only the existing 16-ETF development and historical cubes; no broad-stock or blind snapshot enters ranking or metrics.
